messages.author: 04c79a1892117ce4
messages.subject: RApache and .Rdata
parts:
Hey guys,

I just started playing around with RApache (after having experimented
with RServe, RSRuby, RinRuby, R CMD Batch etc) and I love the fact
that you can load libraries on startup using REvalOnStartup. I've been
looking into the documentation, but could not find anything related to
RData / caching in RApache. My question is therefore the following:

Given some plot that I'm creating using ggplot2, how am I able to
cache / save the RData and reuse it later? Is this possible with
RApache?

Cheers,

Michel

messages.author: c6c81f3e042340b9
messages.subject: Re: RApache and .Rdata
parts:
It's possible, but I don't know where the files should reside. A
basic issue is that of read/write permissions; RApache must have
proper permissions to read and write the RData file wherever it is.

-bb
